514:t_3:120.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Hey, hey! You're going to settle for a quick patch-up?」

514:t_3:121.en:
$$キラ$$
「We've achieved our goal. That's why we have to go.」

514:t_3:123.en:
$$イザーク$$
「We'll hit the ones who got into $$プラント$$. We're leaving the enemies outside to you.」

514:t_4:4.en:
$$ラクス$$
「To everyone watching this broadcast. I am $$ラクス・クライン$$, a member of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.」

514:t_4:5.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Today, $$プラント$$ reorganized the Council, which had ceased to function, and decided to review its cooperative arrangement with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

514:t_4:6.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Also, Defense Committee Chairman $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ has resigned, and a successor is currently being selected.」

514:t_4:7.en:
$$ラクス$$
「We will announce future policy as it develops, but first we wish to reaffirm that we are members of a world that overcomes the past and moves on toward the future.」

514:t_4:8.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Is abandoning our pride and submitting to an invader truly the future we desire?」

514:t_4:9.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Of course, winning that future will require sacrifice.」

514:t_4:10.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But if we fear that, we will make no progress at all and become beings left behind by the times and the world.」

514:t_4:11.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Problems like the declining birth rate of third-generation $$コーディネイター$$s may be due to our having lived only within the closed world of $$プラント$$.」

514:t_4:12.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Now is the time for us to overcome the wall between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s that we inherited from the past, and join hands as people living in this world together.」

514:t_4:13.en:
$$ラクス$$
「As a result... the genetic engineering technology of the $$コーディネイター$$s may fade away.」

514:t_4:14.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But as long as we do not forget the role of world mediator in the words of our progenitor $$ジョージ・グレン$$, our existence will be eternal.」

514:t_4:15.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Right now, many hardships lie before us.」

514:t_4:16.en:
$$ラクス$$
「To overcome them and seize the future, I ask for the cooperation of you all.」

514:t_4:21.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「...Quite impressive, isn't she? $$ラクス$$.」

514:t_4:22.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yes... She seems to have grown stronger again.」

514:t_4:23.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Those few months we spent hiding underground weren't easy, after all.」

514:t_4:24.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But there's no need to worry about the $$プラント$$ side anymore. The Defense Committee Chairman's resignation was backed by many people, and the turmoil inside $$ザフト$$ isn't that big.」

514:t_4:25.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Above all, it seems to have mattered that $$ラクス$$'s speech announced the end of the alliance with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

514:t_4:26.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「So everyone was hoping for peace.」

514:t_4:27.en:
$$メイリン$$
「So that's how it is, Sis... Leave $$プラント$$ to us.」

514:t_4:29.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「If the Supreme Council functions properly, $$プラント$$ will gradually regain its composure. Then we'll have a counteroffensive posture against the Empire ready, too.」

514:t_4:30.en:
$$シン$$
「Is $$プラント$$ going to join the war too!?」

514:t_4:31.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Of course I'd rather avoid war.」

514:t_4:32.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But $$ラクス$$ said it too, didn't she? That yielding to an invader is like throwing away the future.」

514:t_4:33.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Nobody thinks the fighting on Earth is somebody else's problem anymore. Late as it is, $$ザフト$$ will fight the Empire too.」

514:t_4:36.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$アーサー$$ reported in. He let $$レイ#pt136$$ get away and lost the $$レジェンドガンダム$$, he said.」

514:t_4:37.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$アーサー$$ is capable, but he's a bit absent-minded. He's due for a good lecture.」

514:t_4:38.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Well, we're busy with the transition to the new regime, so I'll leave the matter of the Defense Committee Chairman to you.」

514:t_4:40.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「No need to thank me. ...I'm sure he was trying to protect the future of the $$コーディネイター$$s too.」

514:t_4:41.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Well then, until we meet again, $c. We'll be praying for your success.」

514:t_4:42.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$バルトフェルド$$ hasn't changed a bit...」

514:t_4:44.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...I intend to atone with my own hands.」

514:t_4:46.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's a fact that lives were lost because I joined hands with $$フロンタル$$.」

514:t_4:47.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「For the sake of those people, I want to fight with this $c.」

514:t_4:48.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All right, $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. ...At the very least, as a member of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, I have no right to blame you.」

514:t_4:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As I said earlier, if you feel you owe something, you'll have to show it through your actions.」

514:t_4:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm counting on you from now on, $$レイ#pt136$$.」

514:t_4:52.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Just so you know, the battles $c faces are tougher than you can imagine.」

514:t_4:54.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But as long as $$シン$$ is with me, I can keep fighting.」

514:t_4:56.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
($$ギル$$... I don't know how long this life of mine will last...)

514:t_4:57.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
(But until the day it runs out, I will fight. To protect the future $$ギル$$ entrusted to us...)

514:t_4:59.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You had a hard time too, $$アスラン$$.」

514:t_4:62.en:
$$アスラン$$
「...Thinking about it now, I realize Chairman $$デュランダル$$ was also trying to fulfill the role of world mediator...」

514:t_4:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't accept the $$デスティニープラン$$, but there are signs the Chairman was thinking of breaking free from a world ruled by $$クロノ$$.」

514:t_4:65.en:
$$キラ$$
(So that's the true meaning hidden in the $$デスティニープラン$$...)

514:t_4:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's exactly why we, who stopped him, have to move on beyond that.」

514:t_4:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know either. But I believe it can never be reached by the methods of the Chairman or $$フロンタル$$.」

514:t_4:69.en:
$$キラ$$
「Now that we've whittled down $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s forces and cut $$ザフト$$ loose, the counteroffensive against the Empire is finally going to begin.」

514:t_4:70.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's right. We'll go back to $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ once and review our strategy from here.」

514:t_4:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Hurry, $$シャア$$... The time to decide everything is coming soon.)

514:t_4:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
($$フロンタル$$, having lost $$ハマーン$$ and $$ザフト$$, can't possibly stay quiet.)

514:t_4:73.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I'm waiting, $$シャア$$. I'm sure the one who ends this war will be you...)

514:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, Miss $$マリーダ$$. Dealing with $$リディ$$ must have been a handful.」

514:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Take my advice. Getting close to that man really is dangerous.」

514:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand you're curious about him, since you ended up riding the same unit, but if things go wrong, even your life, Miss $$マリーダ$$, could...」

514:t_10:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But $$Ｚチップ$$s were produced, weren't they?」
